question: Can ordinary matched-budget adaptation recover answers from existing frozen prefix carriers, or does allowing prefix computation to adapt help under the same historical-KV restriction?

question_only.description: Preserve pre-question KV/recurrent/convolution computation exactly; adapt only during question/answer processing.

all_tokens.description: Same local targets/parameters; permit prefix as well as question/answer adaptation. Changes both recurrent/convolution state and attention/KV construction.

initialization: Start both controllers at the same zero-output initialization; do not warm-start from old trained controllers.
requirements: Keep existing base Conda/runtime/backbone and every backbone parameter frozen. Save adapter weights only.
Use all the same 128 ordered original examples, answer labels, optimizer settings and 64 updates; do not add current benchmark cases to training.
Apply the records-blocked query/answer mask during every supervised forward and every cached evaluation step; prefix rows retain ordinary causal full attention.
Compare zero-init and detached restoration against native behavior under the identical reader policy, not against unmasked outputs.
Verify finite nonzero adapter gradients, no backbone gradients, and exact question-only prefix caches/logits after a nonzero update.
Keep gradient checkpointing disabled for current hook-based controllers.
Run a real-model safety smoke before training. Evaluate only final checkpoints; no benchmark-based checkpoint selection.
Report current, initial and protected readouts on the original held-out task grid; also report every condition of the reused 24-base-fact benchmark.
Audit actual masks, data/token/checkpoint/source hashes, parameter counts and optimizer-step logs for both arms.

interpretation.question_only_success: Constructive evidence that existing frozen prefix carriers contain usable task information under an adapted readout, not that the original frozen decoder already could recover it.
interpretation.all_tokens_advantage: Functional evidence that changing earlier computation helps for this budget/protocol; not isolated proof of GDN write damage, since prefix attention and KV construction also change.
interpretation.both_fail: Insufficient optimization/expressivity, distribution shift and missing information remain alternatives; no capacity impossibility claim.
interpretation.deployment: A blocked-reader probe is not yet a practical semantic router or an architecture contribution.

evaluation_status: The original test grid and 70000-series cohort are reused diagnostics. They are not new untouched architectural confirmation sets.
followups: Replicate promising effects across the two other fixed initializations before a comparative claim.
Add fresh value/position-matched initial-fact and source-before/after-COPY controls with historical queries.
Compare ordinary augmentation/local adaptation and practical learned access with shared write/read co-design at matched cost before claiming architectural value.
